concerns.text: FR-003 requires computing 'semantic distance' using CodeBERT embeddings. Task T053 exists but is marked [X] (complete) while the Analyze Report flags the implementation as missing and not processing real data. There is no task explicitly verifying the generation of the 'semantic_distance.csv' artifact or the successful execution of the CodeBERT embedding pipeline on the real corpus, creating a gap between the FR requirement and the verified task outcome.

FR-007 mandates correlation analysis at the 'segment level' (function body). The plan and tasks (T033, T032) describe a join using 'problem_id' (HumanEval problem level) to aggregate metrics before correlation. While T032a mentions 'segment-level joins', there is no explicit task verifying that the final correlation calculation in T032/T034 strictly adheres to the segment-level definition in FR-007 and excludes file-level aggregation, risking a violation of the core research requirement.

User Story 3 (Spec) requires generating a 'structural heat map (or confusion matrix)' to visualize code region contributions. Tasks T040 and T041 only describe implementing 'scatter plots with regression lines'. There is no task explicitly assigned to generate the required heat map or confusion matrix visualization, leaving a functional gap for the US3 acceptance scenario.

Tasks T070, T071, T072, T073, T074, T075, T076, T077 are marked [ ] (incomplete) and flagged as 'CRITICAL' in the Analyze Report for failing to remove synthetic data, generate real artifacts, and verify data integrity. The presence of these unchecked critical tasks means the project cannot satisfy the 'Real Data' requirement of the Constitution and Spec, as the pipeline currently relies on synthetic placeholders or unverified states.

Task T018 specifies outputting the dataset to 'data/raw/github_code_subset.parquet', but the Plan and Spec define the raw data file as 'github-code-sample.csv'. There is no task explicitly addressing this file format/naming inconsistency to ensure downstream tasks (T017, T019) can locate the correct file, creating a potential execution failure for the data ingestion pipeline.

Task T076 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and addresses the need to consolidate scattered visualization/checksum logic into the single 'code/visualization.py' module defined in the Plan. Without this task being completed, the project violates the 'Single Source of Truth' principle regarding code structure and risks inconsistent artifact generation.

Task T077 is marked [ ] (incomplete) and explicitly states the need to verify that all critical artifact paths (github-code-sample.csv, clone_metrics.csv, etc.) exist in the exact locations specified. The absence of this verification task means the project cannot confirm the existence of the required outputs for the research results.
